method: cli/src/fourclass classify() per file pair (empty side for created/deleted files), summed per commit; gt = commit-labels-v1 reviewed rows, slice prelabels for zero-move commits. Cross-file moved recall is zero by construction for a per-pair classifier; cross_credit_upper_bound bounds within-pair coincidence credit. GT within-file marks carry git's blocks-mode >=20-alnum block floor; L1's line-level matching may legitimately exceed them (predicted > detected).
